versions.name: RXV2-0.9.531-escprog-link
versions.notes: The wizard's ESC page now links straight to the Scorpion readout (beta) - it was only in A la carte.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.530-scorpion-readout
versions.notes: NEW (beta): ESC settings page reads a Scorpion Tribunus through the flight controller - every setting in plain English, no cables, no Windows. Read-only until hardware-verified; Release button reboots the ESC so telemetry returns.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.529-timings-in-seconds
versions.notes: Governor timings now displayed in SECONDS (converted to Rotorflight's tenths on the wire) - the tenths trap caused a 40-second spool-up on the Goblin's second flight.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.528-govmode-bubble
versions.notes: Governor-mode bubble corrected to RF 2.3's real modes (OFF/LIMIT/DIRECT/ELECTRIC/NITRO) - ELECTRIC is the right choice for electric helis; the old text used RF1 names.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.527-unbrickable
versions.notes: Computer page gains the stuck-flash rescue card: BOOT button + USB = DFU, full chip erase, flash again - and the charge-only-cable trap explained.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.526-fourth-task
versions.notes: The computer session now lists FOUR tasks: firmware, serial port, select CRSF (new - without it there is no communication), Telemetry ON.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.525-help-audit
versions.notes: Help screens audited against the current behaviour: wizard step numbers, alphabetical A la carte, selector bars with nothing to drag, divider-based Arm/Rescue, no x on Bank/Rates, Hello-wave in Receiver settings, selector cards on Switches.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.524-alpha-subtitle
versions.notes: A la carte subtitle says 'In alphabetical order' (the old 'roughly in setup order' was no longer true).

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.523-alacarte-alpha
versions.notes: A la carte menu sorted alphabetically - random-access choices are easiest to find in ABC order.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.522-gear-dedup
versions.notes: Gear-ratio pages lose the paragraph that duplicated the label's help bubble.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.521-tidy-rows
versions.notes: First-time basics, Rescue and Servos pages decluttered: every row is just its underlined title - press for a fuller explanation (43 rows converted).

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.520-hint-on-hub
versions.notes: The help-bubble explanation moves from the wizard to the Rotorflight front page - it applies to everything Rotorflight.
